{{Top|leg}}
'''Star Tours Flight 1126''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. At the time of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight had landed at the spaceport's Gate 1K on time at 0715, and was scheduled to depart again at 0810.
